title: Correction to: Social inequality and cultural factors impact the awareness and reaction during the cryptic transmission period of pandemic
content: This is a correction to: Zhuoren Jiang, Xiaozhong Liu, Yangyang Kang, Changlong Sun, Yong-Yeol Ahn, Johan Bollen, Social inequality and cultural factors impact the awareness and reaction during the cryptic transmission period of pandemic, PNAS Nexus, Volume 4, Issue 2, February 2025, pgaf043, https://doi.org/10.1093/pnasnexus/pgaf043.
